description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon strongly opposes the CLARITY Act's stablecoin provisions. He warns that yield-paying stablecoins could create a dangerous shadow banking system. Traditional banks fear these products lack essential capital and liquidity safeguards. Crypto firms, however, see them as expanding consumer choice and innovation. The debate centers on whether stablecoins can offer interest without traditional regulatory oversight.

description: Meta launched Muse Image, its first AI image generator from Meta Superintelligence Labs, alongside a preview of Muse Video. Chief AI officer Alexandr Wang, one of the company's highest-paid hires, urged users to keep it personal: upload your own photos, tag friends, and pull from trends. title: Connor Murphy dead or alive? Viral YouTube bodybuilder death rumor explained
description: Connor Murphy’s reported death remains an unconfirmed rumor as of July 2026. Claims circulating online largely stem from social media posts and statements that have not been independently verified. No family member, representative, or authority has confirmed his death. Murphy rose to fame through fitness and bodybuilding content, and questions about his current status remain unanswered pending official information.

title: Psychologist reveals what to say instead when your child says, “I can’t do it”
description: Parents often say 'You can do it' to encourage children facing challenges. Psychologist Annie Simpson suggests this phrase can dismiss a child's feelings and create conflict. Instead, phrases like 'Not yet' and 'What's the first tiny piece' foster a growth mindset. These responses acknowledge emotions and guide children toward manageable actions. This approach helps build lasting resilience and confidence in young learners.

title: Manager of a County in Virginia with 35-plus datacenters 'confirms' community datacentre fears
description: As the tech landscape evolves with AI data centers, electricity costs are soaring. Henrico County, Virginia, has announced a staggering 25% hike in electricity bills for government facilities, prompting local officials to urge power conservation among their employees. Residents are also feeling the pinch, with some facing bill doubles. This phenomenon underscores the mounting pressure on community resources amid the rapid expansion of data centers.
